invariants.rationale: This holds as the method always returns a non-null iterator either from super.handleUpdate(...) or Collections.singletonList(...).iterator().
fileId is used in log statements and lookups without any null checks, implying it is never null at this point.
partitionPath is used to construct an AppendHandle or passed into the super method, both expect a non-null value.
recordItr is passed to downstream methods (super.handleUpdate and HoodieAppendHandle ctor) without null checks, so it is expected to be non-null.
